summary: Frontend regression testing after 'editorial organic-food' palette overhaul (soil/gold/leaf/cream/jaggery/charcoal tokens). All commerce flows verified on desktop 1920x1080: Home hero + featured grid + chips + single-variant Quick Add, /collections/best-sellers page scroll + filters + sort + category rail, Product Detail (size/qty/ATC), Cart drawer + checkout btn, Search overlay. No JS console errors captured. No backend changes tested (per request).

design_issues.screen: Global (body element on all routes: Home, /collections/best-sellers, /product/:id)
issues: document.body computed backgroundColor = rgb(255,255,255) pure white while <html> is cream rgb(249,247,243) #F9F7F3. Visible content sections have their own backgrounds so above-fold looks correct, but pure-white body will show through on overscroll bounce (mac trackpad, iOS Safari) and any full-height empty gap. Design brief explicitly asked for 'no leftover pure-white full-page backgrounds on Home/Shop All/Product Detail (background should be warm cream #F9F7F3)'. Fix: add `body { background-color: #F9F7F3; }` in index.css or Tailwind base.

verified_features: Home: hero-carousel present, 3 hero-video dots, header bg rgba(249,247,243,0.85) cream + backdrop blur, footer bg rgb(62,42,30) deep soil brown ✓
Home: featured-grid renders 8 rounded product cards; 8 featured-chip-* chips toggle active state; grid re-renders on chip click ✓
Home Quick Add single-variant: clicking add-to-cart-{id} adds directly (no QuickAddSheet) and header cart badge increments empty -> '1' ✓

/collections/best-sellers: page scrolls fully. docHeight=27583, maxScroll=26503, window.scrollTo reached scrollY=26503 (full range). Mouse-wheel scroll (Lenis smooth-scroll wrapper) reached scrollY=19659 after 20 x 1000px wheel events over 3s — smooth scroll works, no scroll-lock bug. User-reported 'Shop all there should be scroll' is NOT reproducible.
22 category-rail-* tiles render; clicking category-rail-millets navigates to /collections/millets and collection title updates to 'Millets' (visible in screenshot)
sticky-filter-bar: open-filters-btn opens filter-sheet with 35 filter-option-* items; toggling categories navigates to /collections/<slug> and shows applied filter chip; chips-clear-all removes chip

Product Detail (/product/10fc9f88-...): product-detail-page renders, size-option pill (single variant here 'Default Title'), qty-increase/qty-decrease work, add-to-cart-btn adds and increments header cart badge to '3' with qty=3 ✓
Cart drawer: header-cart-btn opens cart-drawer, cart-checkout-btn is present + enabled (no error)
Search overlay: header-search-btn opens overlay with search-input; typing 'ragi' returns 12 search-result-* items; clicking a result navigates to /product/ff68fba2-... ✓
Zero console errors across Home, Best Sellers, Product Detail, Cart drawer, Search flows
Palette applied: header cream + blur, footer soil brown, ATC button soil brown (#3E2A1E), gold-italic accent on hero 'in every grain', jaggery/gold Quick Add pill visible on cards
